CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_schema_digest_v5_139()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.oid::regclass::text,
 'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
 'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(x.oid) order by x.conname) from pg_constraint x where x.conrelid=c.oid),
 'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid),md5(p.prosrc)) order by t.tgname) from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid where t.tgrelid=c.oid and not t.tgisinternal)) order by c.oid::regclass::text),'[]')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where (n.nspname in('public','private') or c.oid='storage.objects'::regclass) and c.relkind in('r','p');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_remote_only_activation_ready_v1(p_account uuid, p_skills text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_skill text;v_norm text;v_category uuid;v_matches bigint;v_profile uuid;
BEGIN
 IF p_account IS NULL OR p_skills IS NULL OR cardinality(p_skills)=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT id INTO v_profile FROM public.app_profiles
 WHERE account_id=p_account AND kind='WORKER' AND skills=p_skills;
 IF v_profile IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
    ON cap.worker_account_id=m.worker_account_id AND cap.category_id=m.category_id
   WHERE m.worker_account_id=p_account AND m.active
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND m.execution_scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'REMOTE')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOREACH v_skill IN ARRAY p_skills LOOP
  IF v_skill IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(v_skill)) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  v_norm:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_skill);
  IF v_norm IS NULL OR v_norm='' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT count(DISTINCT c.id),min(c.id::text)::uuid INTO v_matches,v_category
  FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
  WHERE c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND
    (c.canonical_key=v_norm OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
      WHERE a.category_id=c.id AND a.normalized_key=v_norm));

  IF v_matches=0 THEN
   -- No spelling authority exists. Resolve only the same service/mode at the
   -- same ordinal in the immutable reviewed plan and its committed result.
   -- Existing/ambiguous canonical or alias matches cannot take this fallback.
   SELECT count(*),min(c.id::text)::uuid INTO v_matches,v_category
   FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
   JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
    ON m.worker_account_id=cap.worker_account_id AND m.category_id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c ON c.id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
    ON cm.category_id=m.category_id AND cm.execution_scope=m.execution_scope
   JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
    AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews review
    ON review.id=saved.review_id AND review.account_id=saved.account_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
    ON binding.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND binding.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND binding.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND binding.profile_id=v_profile
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch
    ON batch.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND batch.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND batch.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array'
     THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY plan(value,ord)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
     THEN batch.result->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY item(value,ord)
   WHERE cap.worker_account_id=p_account
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
    AND m.active IS TRUE AND m.execution_scope='REMOTE'
    AND m.confirmed_at=cap.confirmed_at AND m.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at
    AND binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
    AND binding.result->>'workerProfileId'=v_profile::text
    AND binding.bound_at>=saved.created_at
    AND saved.receipt->>'accountId'=p_account::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'reviewId'=review.id::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
    AND saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
    AND review.envelope->>'accountId'=p_account::text
    AND review.envelope->>'reviewId'=review.id::text
    AND review.envelope->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND review.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
    AND review.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
    AND review.created_at<=saved.created_at AND saved.created_at<=review.expires_at
    AND review.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'=encode(extensions.digest(
      ((review.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',review.base_hash))::text,
      'sha256'),'hex')
    AND batch.review_digest=review.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
    AND batch.plans=review.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
    AND batch.plans_digest=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(batch.plans::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    AND batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED' AND batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
    AND batch.result->>'capabilityAuthority'='NONE'
    AND batch.result->>'notificationAuthority'='NONE'
    AND batch.catalog_version=binding.catalog_version
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array'
      THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) BETWEEN 1 AND 24
    AND binding.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END))
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
      THEN batch.result->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)=jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
      THEN review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)=jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope#>'{profile,skills}')='array'
      THEN review.envelope#>'{profile,skills}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) skill(value)
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value)=v_norm)=1
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
      THEN review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) selected(value)
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(selected.value->>'service')=v_norm
        AND selected.value->>'mode'='REMOTE')=1
    AND plan.ord=item.ord AND plan.value->>'action' IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE')
    AND plan.value->>'mode'='REMOTE' AND item.value->>'mode'='REMOTE'
    AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan.value->>'service')=v_norm
    AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(item.value->>'service')=v_norm
    AND plan.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text AND item.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
    AND (plan.value->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff
    AND (NOT(plan.value?'handoff') OR private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(plan.value->'handoff') IS TRUE)
    AND jsonb_typeof(plan.value->'categoryLabel')='string'
    AND plan.value?'categoryParentId'
    AND c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND c.label IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->>'categoryLabel'
    AND coalesce(to_jsonb(c.parent_id),'null'::jsonb) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->'categoryParentId'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories child
      WHERE child.parent_id=c.id AND child.state='ESTABLISHED')
    AND private.taxonomy_category_path_valid_v1(c.id);
  END IF;

  IF v_matches<>1 OR v_category IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
   JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
    ON m.worker_account_id=cap.worker_account_id AND m.category_id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
    ON cm.category_id=m.category_id AND cm.execution_scope=m.execution_scope
   JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
    AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
    ON binding.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND binding.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND binding.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND binding.profile_id=v_profile
   WHERE cap.worker_account_id=p_account AND cap.category_id=v_category
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
    AND m.active IS TRUE AND m.execution_scope='REMOTE'
    AND m.confirmed_at=cap.confirmed_at AND m.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at
    AND binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
    AND saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN true;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_saved_areas_v1(aid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select r.envelope#>'{profile,workAreas}' from private.worker_ai_saves s
 join private.worker_ai_reviews r on r.id=s.review_id and r.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=aid order by s.created_at desc,s.review_id desc limit 1),'[]'::jsonb);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_need_candidates_page(p_need_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_after_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_after_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_need public.needs;
  v_selected_slots integer := 0;
  v_remaining_slots integer := 0;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_has_more boolean;
  v_total bigint;
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='AUTH_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if p_need_id is null then
    raise exception using errcode='22023', message='NEED_ID_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 100 or (p_after_at is null) <> (p_after_id is null) then
    raise exception 'INVALID_PAGE' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select n.* into v_need
  from public.needs n
  where n.id = p_need_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode='P0002', message='NEED_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_need.requester_account_id <> v_actor then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='NOT_REQUESTER';
  end if;

  select coalesce(sum(s.covered_slots),0)::integer
  into v_selected_slots
  from public.need_selections s
  where s.need_id = p_need_id
    and s.status = 'SELECTED';

  v_remaining_slots := greatest(coalesce(v_need.required_slots,1) - v_selected_slots, 0);

  -- EX-04 S4 (A11). The same candidate document rpc_list_need_candidates returns, in its order (submission, then id), one keyset page at a time. The keys of the whole set are read
  -- with no function call; the state, the public profile and the evidence are computed for the candidates of THIS page only, so the work of a page does not grow with the task's applications.
  with keys as materialized (
    select r.id as response_id, coalesce(r.submitted_at, r.created_at) as sort_at
    from public.marketplace_responses r
    where r.need_id = p_need_id
      and r.status <> 'DRAFT'
  ), page as materialized (
    select k.response_id, k.sort_at
    from keys k
    where p_after_at is null or (k.sort_at, k.response_id) > (p_after_at, p_after_id)
    order by k.sort_at, k.response_id
    limit p_limit + 1
  ), shown as materialized (
    select pg.response_id, pg.sort_at
    from page pg
    order by pg.sort_at, pg.response_id
    limit p_limit
  ), candidate_rows as (
    select
      r.id as response_id,
      sh.sort_at,
      r.worker_profile_id,
      r.current_version,
      v.need_revision as version_need_revision,
      v.content_hash,
      v.price_rsd,
      v.price_basis as application_price_basis,
      v.covered_slots,
      v.proposed_start_at,
      v.proposed_end_at,
      v.scope_note,
      snap.snapshot_schema,
      snap.pricing_mode as application_price_mode,
      snap.worker_team_capacity,
      snap.worker_skills,
      snap.worker_tools,
      snap.worker_licenses,
      snap.worker_vehicles
    from shown sh
    join public.marketplace_responses r on r.id = sh.response_id
    left join public.marketplace_response_versions v
      on v.response_id = r.id
     and v.version = r.current_version
    left join private.response_application_snapshots snap
      on snap.response_id = r.id
     and snap.response_version = r.current_version
  ), classified as (
    select
      c.*,
      states.candidate_state
    from candidate_rows c
    join private.need_candidate_states_v5(p_need_id, (select array_agg(sh.response_id) from shown sh)) states on states.response_id = c.response_id
  )
  select
    (select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'responseId', c.response_id,
          'workerProfileId', c.worker_profile_id,
          'needRevision', v_need.revision,
          'responseNeedRevision', c.version_need_revision,
          'version', c.current_version,
          'contentHash', c.content_hash,
          'state', c.candidate_state,
          'canSelect', c.candidate_state = 'SELECTABLE' and coalesce(c.application_price_basis = (case when v_need.mode='MY_PRICE' and v_need.price_basis='HOURLY' then 'HOURLY' else 'TOTAL' end),false),
          'priceReviewRequired', c.application_price_basis is distinct from (case when v_need.mode='MY_PRICE' and v_need.price_basis='HOURLY' then 'HOURLY' else 'TOTAL' end),
          'priceRsd', c.price_rsd,
          'applicationPriceBasis', c.application_price_basis,
          'applicationPriceMode', c.application_price_mode,
          'currency', 'RSD',
          'coveredSlots', c.covered_slots,
          'remainingSlots', v_remaining_slots,
          'proposedStartAt', c.proposed_start_at,
          'proposedEndAt', c.proposed_end_at,
          'scopeNote', coalesce(c.scope_note,''),
          'publicProfile', public.rpc_get_public_profile(c.worker_profile_id),
          'applicationEvidence', case
            when c.snapshot_schema is null then jsonb_build_object(
              'schema','LEGACY_UNPROVEN',
              'teamCapacity',null,
              'skills',null,
              'tools',null,
              'licenses',null,
              'vehicles',null
            )
            else jsonb_build_object(
              'schema',c.snapshot_schema,
              'teamCapacity',c.worker_team_capacity,
              'skills',to_jsonb(c.worker_skills),
              'tools',to_jsonb(c.worker_tools),
              'licenses',to_jsonb(c.worker_licenses),
              'vehicles',to_jsonb(c.worker_vehicles)
            )
          end,
          'sortAt', c.sort_at
        )
        order by c.sort_at, c.response_id
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb) from classified c),
    (select count(*) from page) > p_limit,
    -- The total rides with the first page; a later page does not pay for it again.
    case when p_after_at is null then (select count(*) from keys) end
  into v_items, v_has_more, v_total;

  -- CAL01: boolean only, behind the existing owner-scoped reader; no foreign agreement details.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item || jsonb_build_object('calendarConflict',
    private.application_calendar_conflict_v1((item->>'responseId')::uuid)) order by ord), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items from jsonb_array_elements(v_items) with ordinality as entries(item,ord);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item || case when item->>'calendarConflict'='true' then '{"canSelect":false}'::jsonb else '{}'::jsonb end order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items from jsonb_array_elements(v_items) with ordinality as entries(item,ord);

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'items', v_items,
    'hasMore', v_has_more,
    'counts', case when p_after_at is null then jsonb_build_object('total', v_total) end,
    'asOf', statement_timestamp());
end
$function$
functions.arguments: p_need_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_after_at timestamp with time zone, p_after_id uuid

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_need_candidates(p_need_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_need public.needs;
  v_selected_slots integer := 0;
  v_remaining_slots integer := 0;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='AUTH_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if p_need_id is null then
    raise exception using errcode='22023', message='NEED_ID_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  select n.* into v_need
  from public.needs n
  where n.id = p_need_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode='P0002', message='NEED_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_need.requester_account_id <> v_actor then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='NOT_REQUESTER';
  end if;

  select coalesce(sum(s.covered_slots),0)::integer
  into v_selected_slots
  from public.need_selections s
  where s.need_id = p_need_id
    and s.status = 'SELECTED';

  v_remaining_slots := greatest(coalesce(v_need.required_slots,1) - v_selected_slots, 0);

  with candidate_rows as (
    select
      r.id as response_id,
      r.worker_profile_id,
      r.status as raw_response_status,
      r.current_version,
      r.submitted_against_need_revision,
      r.submitted_at,
      v.need_revision as version_need_revision,
      v.content_hash,
      v.price_rsd,
      v.price_basis as application_price_basis,
      v.covered_slots,
      v.proposed_start_at,
      v.proposed_end_at,
      v.scope_note,
      snap.snapshot_schema,
      snap.pricing_mode as application_price_mode,
      snap.worker_team_capacity,
      snap.worker_skills,
      snap.worker_tools,
      snap.worker_licenses,
      snap.worker_vehicles,
      p.profile_status as current_profile_status,
      p.display_name as current_display_name,
      p.city as current_city,
      p.skills as current_skills,
      p.team_capacity as current_team_capacity,
      public.rpc_get_public_profile(r.worker_profile_id) as public_profile,
      exists(
        select 1
        from public.agreements a
        where a.selected_response_id = r.id
      ) as has_agreement
    from public.marketplace_responses r
    left join public.marketplace_response_versions v
      on v.response_id = r.id
     and v.version = r.current_version
    left join private.response_application_snapshots snap
      on snap.response_id = r.id
     and snap.response_version = r.current_version
    left join public.app_profiles p
      on p.id = r.worker_profile_id
     and p.kind = 'WORKER'
    where r.need_id = p_need_id
      and r.status <> 'DRAFT'
  ), classified as (
    select
      c.*,
      states.candidate_state
    from candidate_rows c
    join private.need_candidate_states_v5(p_need_id) states on states.response_id=c.response_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'responseId', c.response_id,
        'workerProfileId', c.worker_profile_id,
        'needRevision', v_need.revision,
        'responseNeedRevision', c.version_need_revision,
        'version', c.current_version,
        'contentHash', c.content_hash,
        'state', c.candidate_state,
        'canSelect', c.candidate_state = 'SELECTABLE' and coalesce(c.application_price_basis = (case when v_need.mode='MY_PRICE' and v_need.price_basis='HOURLY' then 'HOURLY' else 'TOTAL' end),false),
          'priceReviewRequired', c.application_price_basis is distinct from (case when v_need.mode='MY_PRICE' and v_need.price_basis='HOURLY' then 'HOURLY' else 'TOTAL' end),
        'priceRsd', c.price_rsd,
          'applicationPriceBasis', c.application_price_basis,
          'applicationPriceMode', c.application_price_mode,
          'currency', 'RSD',
        'coveredSlots', c.covered_slots,
        'remainingSlots', v_remaining_slots,
        'proposedStartAt', c.proposed_start_at,
        'proposedEndAt', c.proposed_end_at,
        'scopeNote', coalesce(c.scope_note,''),
        'publicProfile', c.public_profile,
        'applicationEvidence', case
          when c.snapshot_schema is null then jsonb_build_object(
            'schema','LEGACY_UNPROVEN',
            'teamCapacity',null,
            'skills',null,
            'tools',null,
            'licenses',null,
            'vehicles',null
          )
          else jsonb_build_object(
            'schema',c.snapshot_schema,
            'teamCapacity',c.worker_team_capacity,
            'skills',to_jsonb(c.worker_skills),
            'tools',to_jsonb(c.worker_tools),
            'licenses',to_jsonb(c.worker_licenses),
            'vehicles',to_jsonb(c.worker_vehicles)
          )
        end
      )
      order by c.submitted_at asc nulls last, c.response_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_result
  from classified c;

  -- CAL01: boolean only, behind the existing owner-scoped reader; no foreign agreement details.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item || jsonb_build_object('calendarConflict',
    private.application_calendar_conflict_v1((item->>'responseId')::uuid)) order by ord), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result from jsonb_array_elements(v_result) with ordinality as entries(item,ord);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item || case when item->>'calendarConflict'='true' then '{"canSelect":false}'::jsonb else '{}'::jsonb end order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result from jsonb_array_elements(v_result) with ordinality as entries(item,ord);

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agreements a
  WHERE ((a.id = agreement_versions.agreement_id) AND ((a.requester_account_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (a.worker_account_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (agreement_id) REFERENCES agreements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (created_by_account_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (need_id) REFERENCES needs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (requester_account_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (requester_profile_id) REFERENCES app_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (selection_id) REFERENCES need_selections(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((worker_dispatch_eligible_since IS NULL) AND (worker_dispatch_clock_source IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'WORKER'::text) AND (worker_dispatch_eligible_since IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(worker_dispatch_eligible_since) AND (worker_dispatch_clock_source IS NOT NULL) AND (worker_dispatch_clock_source = ANY (ARRAY['FIRST_ACTIVATION'::text, 'ROLLOUT_ACTIVE_OBSERVED'::text])))))

   FROM marketplace_responses r
  WHERE ((r.id = marketplace_response_versions.response_id) AND ((r.worker_account_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((r.status <> 'DRAFT'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM needs n
          WHERE ((n.id = r.need_id) AND is_my_task(n.id)))))))))

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (response_id) REFERENCES marketplace_responses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

relations.name: public.marketplace_responses

policies.name: responses_requester_read
policies.using:
((status <> 'DRAFT'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM needs n
  WHERE ((n.id = marketplace_responses.need_id) AND is_my_task(n.id)))))

constraints: CHECK ((((proposed_start_at IS NULL) AND (proposed_end_at IS NULL)) OR ((proposed_start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_end_at IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_start_at < proposed_end_at))))
FOREIGN KEY (need_id) REFERENCES needs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (need_id) REFERENCES needs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (response_id) REFERENCES marketplace_responses(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (selected_by_account_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (worker_account_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (worker_profile_id) REFERENCES app_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
